concerns.location: plan.md:Section 3 – Baseline Verifier Evaluation (FR‑003) / research.md:Section 9 – GPU Escape Hatch Note
concerns.text: The plan relies on a ‘GPU escape hatch’ (Kaggle free GPU) for the 1 B‑parameter Edit‑R1 verifier because the model exceeds the 7 GB RAM limit on a CPU‑only runner. This violates the project’s free‑compute constraint: all steps must be runnable on the GitHub Actions free‑tier runner (2 CPU cores, ≤ 7 GB RAM) without external paid or out‑of‑scope resources. Consequently the baseline verifier runtime budget (≤ 2 h) and overall ≤ 6 h wall‑clock limit are unrealistic on CPU alone, making the pipeline infeasible as written.
